description: Retrieve recent fuel fill-up records for the user's vehicles, including litres pumped, fuel grade, price per litre, total ZAR cost, station name, logged date, and calculated L/100km fuel economy.

limit.description: Maximum number of fuel logs to return (default 25, max 100).

search.description: Optional search keyword for station name or notes.

vehicle_id.description: Optional ID of a specific vehicle to filter fuel logs.

name: list_fuel_logs
